introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - Ordinary Level Examination. Computer Science (0595), Paper 3 (practical), June 2021. Duration: two and a half hours. Do all tasks (Task I, Task II, Task III) in this question paper.**

The booklet reproduced here contains three versions of the same practical paper, headed Group One, Group Two and Group Three (booklets GCE/P/2021/0595/3/C/Grp 1, Grp 2 and Grp 3). Each version has three tasks: Task I (word processing, 20 marks), Task II (spreadsheet, 20 marks) and Task III (reading and running a short C or Pascal program, 10 marks). A candidate works on one group only (the printed paper does not say how the groups are allotted).

Enter the information required in the shaded boxes. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. All written answers should be provided in the spaces provided in this question booklet. Calculators are NOT allowed.

The working files named in the tasks (the picture 'CornerShop' found on the desktop, Group Two Task II) are supplied on the day; they are not reproduced in the printed paper.
enonce_intro_markdown:
**GROUP THREE - TASK 1 (20 marks)**

Examine the text below and answer the questions that follow.

> Prevalence of ICTs in Bangoh District
>
> The spread and adoption of information and communication technologies (ICTs) throughout the country was phenomenal in the early 2000s, and Bangoh District was not left behind. More people than ever are today using the following ICTS:
>
> Radio
>
> Smart phones
>
> Television, etc.
>
> However, only relatively few people have reliable access to the internet because of the high costs. Even with this limitation, mobile phone technology is revolutionizing the technology landscape and today, is by far the fastest growing ICT in the country.
>
> Smart Telecoms was the first mobile provider in with a fair coverage in Bangoh. New Way Telecoms and Big Brains Communications followed later, and all three are currently doing well in terms of coverage and stability.
>
> Formerly, TV signals were only possible via satellite. But today, many antennas have been raised around the community and TV signals are available both terrestrially and by satellite. Even cable TV operators are doing good business.
>
> The table below indicates the level of usage of ICT tools in Bangoh District.
>
> | ICT Tools | Radio | Television | Smart phones | Internet |
> |---|---|---|---|---|
> | Usage | 60% | 70% | 65% | 20% |
incertitudes: Le PDF (18 pages, scan sans couche texte) contient TROIS versions du meme sujet pratique : « Group One » (pages 1 a 6, livret GCE/P/2021/0595/3/C/Grp 1), « Group Two » (pages 7 a 12, Grp 2) et « Group Three » (pages 13 a 18, Grp 3), chacune avec Task I (traitement de texte, 20 points), Task II (tableur, 20 points) et Task III (programme C ou Pascal, 10 points). Page de garde verifiee : ORDINARY LEVEL, COMPUTER SCIENCE, 0595, Paper 3, juin 2021, 2h30. Transcrites en neuf fichiers : numero_exercice G1-T1, G1-T2, G1-T3, G2-T1, ..., G3-T3 ; groupes ["GROUP 1"], ["GROUP 2"] ou ["GROUP 3"]. Le sujet n'impose pas expressement de ne traiter qu'une version (le candidat ne passe en pratique qu'un groupe) : non exprimable, regles_choix reste vide. De meme, a la Task III le sujet dit « Select any one of them » (programme C ou Pascal) : non exprimable.

Les filigranes gcerevision.com / Kawlo, les cadres d'en-tete (numero de centre, nom du candidat, « For examiners' use only »), les lignes a completer, les textes fantomes du verso (le papier est translucide) et les artefacts de scanner sont ignores. Le fichier-image « CornerShop » (Group Two, Task II) et les fichiers du bureau ne figurent pas dans le PDF.

Aucun logiciel (traitement de texte, tableur) n'a ete execute : les menus et les etapes sont donnes de memoire (Office recent) et ne sont pas testes. Les formules de tableur ont ete traduites en Python et executees sur les donnees du sujet (totaux, moyennes, calcul des frais, tri). Aucun compilateur C ou Pascal n'est disponible : les programmes du sujet n'ont pas ete compiles, leur logique a ete verifiee par une simulation Python fidele (division entiere et reste, memes entrees, memes sorties) dont les resultats sont recopies dans les corriges.
Aucun corrige officiel n'existe : les reponses sont redigees. Les repartitions de points dans les corriges (« marking idea ») sont indicatives ; les points imprimes du sujet ne sont jamais modifies.

Pascal : les entiers du programme sont declares « integer ». Sur un compilateur a entiers de 16 bits (maximum 32767, cas d'anciens Turbo Pascal ou du mode par defaut de certains compilateurs) une entree comme 45678 (Group One) provoque un depassement ; sur un compilateur a entiers de 32 bits (cas usuel, et int en C) le resultat est celui donne. Le corrige indique la sortie attendue sur une machine a entiers de 32 bits. En Pascal ISO la largeur d'affichage par defaut d'un entier est definie par l'implementation : le corrige suppose l'affichage sans blancs de tete (cas usuel).

Task 1, Group Three : les points imprimes (8 + 4 + 4 + 2 + 2 = 20) correspondent a l'en-tete ; les questions 6 et 7 (save, print) n'ont pas de points. Les marques sont decalees par le texte fantome du verso : lues question par question (1 : 8, 2 : 4, 3 : 4, 4 : 2, 5 : 2).

Fautes d'impression recopiees telles quelles : « the following ICTS », « the first mobile provider in with a fair coverage ». Dans le passage, la liste « Radio / Smart phones / Television, etc. » est lue comme trois lignes distinctes. Les « row headings » de la question 4 sont lus comme les cellules « ICT Tools » et « Usage » (premiere colonne du tableau). Le tableau des usages est un tableau de 5 colonnes et 2 lignes, comme imprime.

questions.enonce_markdown: Launch a word processor. Set the page orientation to portrait, and the page size to A4. Type the given passage. You are not required to place a border around the passage.  *[8 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
1. Open the word processor (for example *Start* > *Microsoft Word* > *Blank document*).
2. *Layout* tab > **Orientation** > **Portrait**; **Size** > **A4**.
3. Type the passage exactly as printed: the title *Prevalence of ICTs in Bangoh District*; the first paragraph (ending with *the following ICTS:*); the three short lines *Radio*, *Smart phones*, *Television, etc.* (one per line, press *Enter* after each); the three paragraphs that follow (*However, ...*, *Smart Telecoms ...*, *Formerly, ...*); the sentence *The table below indicates the level of usage of ICT tools in Bangoh District.*; then insert a table (*Insert* > **Table** > **5 columns x 2 rows**) and type *ICT Tools | Radio | Television | Smart phones | Internet* in the first row and *Usage | 60% | 70% | 65% | 20%* in the second row.
4. Keep the spelling and the punctuation as printed (the text says *ICTS* in the first paragraph and *in with a fair coverage*; copy what is printed). No border is drawn around the passage.

*Marking idea:* about 2 marks for the page setup and 6 marks for the accurate typing of the text and of the table (indicative split; the Board's mark scheme is not known).
